integrity: The exponent is proved from exact Cantor cylinder masses and interval inclusions; no numerical evidence is used as proof.
The result is presented as a narrow sharpness benchmark, not as an independent or general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exact sharpness statement only for the standard middle-third Cantor measure and monomials x^m on the ambient real line.
No general quantitative Lojasiewicz exponent or Fourier-decay rate is asserted.
title: Exact exponent cap for thickened Cantor sublevel sets
